'''2001 Chewbacca Con Space Sectors (29 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG space/sectors tournament (non-sanctioned) held in Boxborough, Massachusetts on 29 July 2001. [[Michael Hawley]] won it. It is known from Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2748">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-hydchewbaccacon-space-sectors-7-29d2748/ hydchewbaccacon-space-sectors-7-29], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 31 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-hydchewbaccacon-space-sectors-7-29d2748/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Chewbacca Con]].

* '''Date:''' 29 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Boxborough, Massachusetts
* '''Players:''' 2
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Hawley]]
